name: Coase

subjectOf.text: Decentralized solutions can challenge the basic assumptions of the theory of the firm, because the role of the firm changes if decentralized technology lowers the cost of using markets exponentially.
subjectOf.abstract: Decentralized solutions for human interaction can challenge the basic assumptions of the theory of the firm. In other words, the role of the firm may change if decentralized solutions help lower the cost of using markets exponentially.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860
scope_conditions: if decentralized solutions actually lower transaction costs for a significant portion of market transactions

subjectOf.text: Inexpensive open source smart contracts eliminate a major motivation for creating a firm under Coase's transaction cost theory, because they enable trustworthy transactions of any size with minimal transaction cost and high transaction security.
subjectOf.abstract: Inexpensive open-source smart contracts eliminate a major motivation for creating a firm under Ronald Coase's transaction cost theory.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain-Based Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3441904
scope_conditions: transactions that can be executed through smart contracts

subjectOf.text: When all five drivers of positive transaction costs approach zero at once, transaction costs themselves asymptotically approach zero, a point the author names the Coasean Singularity: the point at which the rationale for the firm, for hierarchical governance, for relational contracting and for most formal institutions disappears.
